summary: The identity fix worked (comparison 0 violated by the non-snapshot case's abort witness), but comparison 1 remained unknown because both cases emitted the same result event name, so each comparison also evaluated the other case's outcome event and could not complete. Submitted a further revision of the same contrast experiment with per-case endpoint event names (log_sync_outcome_nosnapshot / log_sync_outcome_snapshot); message sequence, configuration and measured endpoint unchanged, previous_id and revision reason recorded.
